title: Kenyan Vegetable Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful Kenyan-inspired vegetable skillet recipe, perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: Skillet oil (such as coconut or olive oil)

instructions: Heat the skillet oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onions and bell peppers to the skillet and sauté for 5 minutes.
Add the sweet potatoes and carrots to the skillet and continue to sauté for another 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and herbs to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 15 minutes.
